Header: Ralstonia spp , Erwinia spp. Sinhala: “bulba kunuweema”

Prevention: Use disease free seedlings /bulbs for cultivation
Crop rotation with non lilaceous crops e.g. maize, finger millet, legumes
Use of organic manure i.e. compost
Soil sterilization by solarization exposing to direct sun light
Avoid cultivation of susceptible varieties like
Proper land preparation i.e. raised beds or separate channel to remove excess water
Monitoring: Regular field visit to observe rotten bulb
Check infected bulbs for bacterial oozing by dipping in clean glass of water
Take action when symptoms first seen/detected
Observe soft rot symptoms in middle young leaves for bacterial rot (fungal rot symptoms started from mature outer leaves, leaf yellowing, slight twisting)
Direct Control: Removal of infected bulbs with surrounding soil at 10 day intervals and destroy e.g. by burning and burying
Soil sterilization by exposing infected area to direct sun light after removal of infected plants
Avoid surface irrigation from infected field to healthy field
Restrictions: Use of chemicals is not recommended for bulb rot management
